implementation.name: original-v2-moe-all-to-all-routing
implementation.scope: The original sixteen tokens a–p, four ranks, and one expert per rank. Top-1 routing; prime marks an expert output, not a numerical value. One forward pass; backward exchanges are outside this sequence.
implementation.question: How does each expert result find its original token?

purpose: How does each expert result find its original token?
storyboard: Each rank owns four tokens and records their original positions. The gate assigns one expert to each token.
All sixteen tokens follow the original top-1 assignment. Expert 2 receives a from rank 0; each expert receives one token from every rank.
Each expert transforms its assigned tokens. a becomes a′ at Expert 2. The origin rank and token position stay attached to the result.
The second exchange returns each expert output to its original rank and slot. a′ returns to rank 0, slot a; dispatch destinations are not the output owners.
Each original rank applies its gate weight to its returned outputs. Top-1 has one expert result per token; no second expert contribution is invented.
guard: Exact original token-to-expert assignment and inverse permutation. Prime denotes expert transformation; output returns to token owner. Top-1 only; no fabricated numeric activation, bandwidth, or load claim.
